svg.title: Mouse-bite clearances at a breakaway tab
svg.desc: A close-up of a board edge at a tab, enlarged and drawn to scale. Non-plated holes 0.5 mm across run along the edge, each pulled back 0.1 mm from the edge. Traces, pads and plated holes are kept at least 0.5 mm from the holes, which puts them at least 1.1 mm from the board edge.

g.text: Nearest trace, pad or plated hole
At least 0.5 mm from the holes
Drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm.
